feat(api): v2 list and get events (#5095)

# Summary

adds `GET /v2/events` and `GET /v2/events/{event_id}`, with matching cli
and mcp tools. covers

list is newest first and can filter by time range and event name. events
return metadata only; the payload is opt-in with `include=payload`, and
payload pages are capped at 5 events. internal `inngest/` events are
hidden. new `events:read:list` and `events:read:get` permissions are
covered by `events:read:*`. cloud side: inngest/monorepo#9347.

EXE-1768 and EXE-1769 

tested end to end on the dev server over http, cli and mcp.

# How to revert

revert this pr. revert the monorepo pr first, since it vendors this one.

# Release notes

- api: `GET /v2/events`, `GET /v2/events/{event_id}`
- cli: `inngest api list-events`, `inngest api get-event <event-id>`
- mcp: `list_events`, `get_event`
